chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Blackbirds closing, the Berry Brothers and Jig-Saw Jackson
summary: The show folded after 12 to 14 weeks; he describes the Berry Brothers' strut dancing and the roller-skating, contortionist Jig-Saw Jackson, and how good the show felt.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: It was a popular show, though, wasn't it?
Yes, it was.
Why did it close so quickly?
Not quickly, it just closed because there wasn't much business going on, I guess.
Who else was in that show besides Ethel Waters?
The Berry Brothers.
What kind of act were they?

Jig-Saw Jackson. They were a dancing team, a trio, a dancing trio, three brothers, called The Berry Brothers. They were some dancers, too. Did a number called 'Papa Dee-Da-Da' used to strut to it, you know. It was terrific, yeah. And I used to laugh, it would be so interesting to watch them work, you know. They were really nice. 'Course all of them are dead now, except one, the youngest one, he's still alive, he's living in California.
Did they do a lot of acrobatics?
No, this was just straight dancing, straight dancing, they did no acrobats, just bug dancing and strut, style dancing, that's all.
And who else was in that show?
Quite a lot of
people, no name known people. The only known was Ethel Waters and Buck and Bubbles, Jig-Saw Jackson and The Berry Brothers.
Jig-Saw Jackson, I'm not familiar with him.
He's a guy that dances --he likes to dance on his roller skates, you know. He'd just dance on roller skates.
You mean like the disco roller skating that goes on?
Yeah, he'd just put roller skates on and start dancing.
Did he tap dance at all?
Yeah, Yeah. Then he did a contortionist dance like he'd bend himself all around, feet over here , bend his back -- contortionist-like, you know. He was clever.
A novelty number.
Yeah, novelty.
Mh-hm, that's right. Were there other things that you and Ethel Waters did together -- you and Buck?
Only in "Blackbirds."
Were there any other tunes in "Blackbirds" as well? Any other tunes that you sang in "Blackbirds" as well as the one that you already sang?
No, I only sang one to this girl. "Lucky to Me."
That must have been something.
It was something. It was a good show, but it didn't last so long.
How did it feel being on stage there and having the audience respond so --
It felt great because I had something to offer. I felt good because I had something to offer. That's what
made me feel good. If I didn't have an offer I wouldn't feel good at all. That's why I enjoyed being in the show.
